name_zh: 卡拉乔尔杰/米洛舍维奇/塞尔维亚领袖：巴尔干生存外交与大国平衡
name_en: Karadjordje/Milosevic/Serbian Leaders: Balkan Survival Diplomacy & Great Power Balancing
description_zh: 塞尔维亚作为巴尔干核心枢纽，历经卡拉乔尔杰 (1768-1817) 首次起义建国、米洛舍维奇 (1941-2006) 南斯拉夫解体/科索沃战争/海牙审判、武契奇 (1970-) 欧盟入盟/科索沃常态化/中俄平衡三代领袖。核心生存逻辑：大国夹缝(奥/俄/德/美/土)→正教身份锚定→军事/情报非对称优势→流散网络杠杆。体现 M182 巴尔干生存外交——以"正教身份+军事威慑+大国摇摆+流散网络"四位一体，在文明断层线上实现国家生存延续。
description_en: Serbia as Balkan pivotal hub across three generations: Karadjordje (1768-1817) First Uprising statehood, Milosevic (1941-2006) Yugoslavia dissolution/Kosovo War/Hague trial, Vucic (1970-) EU accession/Kosovo normalization/China-Russia balance. Core survival logic: great power interstice (Austro/Russian/German/US/Turk) -> Orthodox identity anchor -> military/intel asymmetric advantage -> diaspora network leverage. Exemplifies M182 Balkan Survival Diplomacy—quaternity of 'Orthodox identity + military deterrence + great power oscillation + diaspora networks' achieving state survival continuity on civilizational fault lines.
reason_zh: 塞尔维亚生存史是"正教身份+军事威慑+大国平衡"三位一体：卡拉乔尔杰以正教起义建国，米洛舍维奇以军事/民族主义维持大塞尔维亚，武契奇以欧盟/中俄平衡求生存。M182 区隔于 M172 少数派生存(叙利亚)、M163 斯拉夫边境生存(乌克兰)、M170 部落联邦(伊拉克)，核心在于"正教身份锚定+军事非对称+大国代理人平衡"的巴尔干生存范式。
reason_en: Serbian survival history is trinity of 'Orthodox identity + military deterrence + great power balancing': Karadjordje built state via Orthodox uprising, Milosevic maintained Greater Serbia via military/nationalism, Vucic seeks survival via EU/China-Russia balance. M182 distinct from M172 Minority Survival (Syria), M163 Slavic Borderland Survival (Ukraine), M170 Tribal Federalism (Iraq), core: 'Orthodox identity anchor + military asymmetry + great power proxy balancing' Balkan survival paradigm.
steps_zh: 正教身份建国锚定：1804 卡拉乔尔杰起义以正教捍卫者自居，圣萨瓦精神凝聚民族共同体
军事威慑与非对称战争：1815 第二次起义/1912-13 巴尔干战争/1990s 南斯拉夫战争/1999 北约轰炸，军事意志为核心杠杆
大国间摇摆平衡：奥斯曼/奥匈/俄/德/美/中/欧，始终在两大阵营间寻找生存空间，从不彻底倒向单边
流散网络杠杆运用：美/德/奥/加/澳塞尔维亚侨民 300 万+，政治游说/资金汇款/技术回流，侨民成战略纵深
欧盟入盟与科索沃常态化：武契奇推进 EU 入盟谈判/科索沃对话常态化/中俄战略伙伴/军事中立，四面平衡求生存
steps_en: Orthodox identity state-building anchor: 1804 Karadjordje uprising as Orthodox defender, St. Sava spirit coalesces national community
Military deterrence & asymmetric warfare: 1815 Second Uprising/1912-13 Balkan Wars/1990s Yugoslav Wars/1999 NATO bombing, military will as core leverage
Great power oscillation balancing: Ottoman/Austro-Hungarian/Russian/German/US/China/EU, always seeking survival space between two blocs, never fully tilting to one side
Diaspora network leverage: 3M+ Serbian diaspora in US/DE/AT/CA/AU, political lobbying/remittances/tech return flow, diaspora as strategic depth
EU accession & Kosovo normalization: Vucic advances EU talks/Kosovo dialogue normalization/China-Russia strategic partnership/military neutrality, four-way balance for survival
expected_zh: 以"正教身份+军事威慑+大国摇摆+流散网络"四位一体，在奥/匈/俄/德/土/美/中/欧八强夹缝中实现两百年国家生存延续，为巴尔干小国提供极限生存范式。
expected_en: Quaternity of 'Orthodox identity + military deterrence + great power oscillation + diaspora networks' achieves two-century state survival continuity in eight-power squeeze of Austro-Hungarian/Russian/German/Turkish/US/Chinese/EU, providing extreme survival paradigm for Balkan small states.
case_zh: 1804 首次起义→1815 第二次起义→1878 柏林会议独立→1912-13 巴尔干战争扩张→1918 南斯拉夫建国→1990s 解体战争/海牙审判→2000 米洛舍维奇倒台→2008 科索沃单方面独立→2020s 武契奇欧盟/中俄平衡，两百年国家生存延续。
case_en: 1804 First Uprising -> 1815 Second Uprising -> 1878 Berlin Congress independence -> 1912-13 Balkan Wars expansion -> 1918 Yugoslavia founded -> 1990s dissolution wars/Hague trial -> 2000 Milosevic fall -> 2008 Kosovo unilateral independence -> 2020s Vucic EU/China-Russia balance, two-century state survival continuity.
cross_cultural_impact: Balkan survival model; Orthodox geopolitics; diaspora statecraft; great power balancing
colonial_history: Ottoman rule 1459-1878; Austro-Hungarian occupation 1915-18; Nazi occupation 1941-44
resource_curse_mitigation: Limited resources; agriculture/auto/defense industry; Chinese/Russian investment
